arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوْتُ وَأَحْيَا
translit: bismika, allahumma amuutu wa ahyaa
english: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
title: Supplication Before Sleeping

arabic: غُفْرَانَكَ
translit: ghuf-raanak
english: I ask for Your forgiveness (O Allah).
title: Supplication Leaving the Bathroom

arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
translit: bismillah
english: In the name of Allah.
source: HR. al-Bukari No. 5376 and Muslim No. 2022
title: Supplication Before Eating

arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِيْ أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
translit: allahummaftah lii abwaaba rahmatika
english: O Allah, open the doors of Your mercy for me.
title: Supplication Entering the Mosque

arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
translit: allahumma innii as'aluka min fadhlika
english: O Allah, I ask You for Your bounty.
title: Supplication Leaving the Mosque

arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ وثَبَتَ اْلأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَاللهُ
translit: dzahabazh zhoma'u wabtallatil 'uruqu wa tsabatal ajru insya Allah
english: The thirst has gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.
source: HR. Abu Daud, As-Sunan Al-Kubra Lil Baihaqi, Vol. 4, p. 239, al-Hakim in Mustadrak 'alas Shahihain No. 1484
title: Supplication for Breaking the Fast

arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ
translit: assalaamu 'alaykum
english: Peace be upon you.
title: Supplication Entering the House #1

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّى أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَضِلَّ أَوْ أُضَلَّ أَوْ أَزِلَّ أَوْ أُزَلَّ أَوْ أَظْلِمَ أَوْ أُظْلَمَ أَوْ أَجْهَلَ أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَىَّ
translit: allaahumma innii a'uudzu bika an adhilla au udholla, au azilla au azulla, au azhlima au uzhlama, au ajhala au yujhala 'alayya
english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You lest I should stray or be led astray, slip or be tripped, wrong or be wronged, or act foolishly or have foolishness done to me.
source: HR. Abu Dawud, at-Tirmidzi, Ibn Majah and an-Nasa'i
title: Supplication for Protection from Causing or Experiencing Harm Outside the House

arabic: الله أَكْبَرُ،الله أَكْبَرُ،الله أَكْبَرُ،سُبْحَانَ الَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِى سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِى السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِى الأَهْلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّى أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِى الْمَالِ وَالأَهْلِ
translit: allahu akbar, allahu akbar, allahu akbar. subhaanal ladzi sakh-khara lanaa haadza wa maa kunna lahuu muqriniin wa inna ilaa rabbina lamun qalibuun. allahumma inna nas aluka fii safarina hadzaa al-birra wat taqwa wa minal amali maa tardhaa. allahumma hawwin 'alaina safarana haadza wathwi 'anna bu'dahu. allahumma anta shaahibu fi safar. wal khaliifatu fil ahli. allahumma inni a'uudzubika min wa'tsaa-issafari wa ka-aabatil mandzari wa suuil munqalabi fil maali wal ahli
english: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. Glory be to Him who has provided this for us, though we could never have had it by our own efforts. Surely to our Lord we are returning. O Allah, we ask You for righteousness and piety in this journey of ours, and for deeds that please You. O Allah, lighten for us the hardship of this journey and quickly bring us to our destination. O Allah, You are our Companion on the journey and the Guardian of our families. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardship of travel, from a bad return, and from seeing something unpleasant concerning our wealth, family, or children.
title: Travel Supplication

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيهِ أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهِ وَخَيْرِ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ
translit: allahumma lakal hamdu anta kasawtaniihi. as-aluka min khoirihi wa khoiri maa shuni'a lah, wa a'udzu bika min syarrihi wa syarri maa shuni'a lah
english: O Allah, to You is all praise. You have clothed me with this. I ask You for its goodness and the goodness for which it was made, and I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil for which it was made.
source: HR. Ahmad, Abu Dawud, at-Tirmidzi and Al-Hakim
title: Supplication When Wearing New Clothes

arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِى كَسَانِى هَذَا الثَّوْبَ وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّى وَلاَ قُوَّةٍ
translit: alhamdu lillaahil ladzii kasaanii haadzaa wa rozaqoniihi min ghoiri hawlim minni wa laa quwwatin
english: Praise be to Allah who has clothed me with this garment and provided it for me without any power or strength from me.
source: HR. all compilers of Sunan books, except Nasa'i
title: Supplication When Wearing Clothes

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ حَوَالَيْنَا وَلاَ عَلَيْنَا ، اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى الآكَامِ وَالظِّرَابِ وَبُطُونِ الأَوْدِيَةِ وَمَنَابِتِ الشَّجَرِ
translit: allahumma haawalaina wa laa 'alaina. allahumma 'alal aakami wal jibaali, wazh zhiroobi, wa buthunil awdiyati, wa manaabitisy syajari
english: O Allah, (let the rain fall) around us, not on us. O Allah, (let it fall) on the hills, mountains, small mountains, valleys, and places where trees grow.
title: Supplication During Heavy Rain

arabic: مُطِرْنا بفَضْلِ اللهِ ورَحْمَتِهِ
translit: muthirna bi fadhlillahi wa rohmatih
english: We have been given rain by the bounty and mercy of Allah.
source: HR. al-Bukhari No. 846 and Muslim No. 71
title: Supplication After it Rains

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ سَهْلَ إِلاَّ مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلاً وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلاً
translit: allahumma laa sahla illa maa ja'altahu sahlaa, wa anta taj'alul hazna idza syi'ta sahlaa
english: O Allah, there is no ease except in that which You make easy, and You make the difficult easy if You wish.
title: Supplication for Ease in All Matters

arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِى فِى مُصِيبَتِى وَأَخْلِفْ لِى خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
translit: inna lillahi wa inna ilaihi rooj'un. allahumma'jurnii fii mushibatii wa akhlif lii khoiron minhaa
english: Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return. O Allah, reward me for my affliction and replace it with something better.
title: Supplication When Afflicted by Calamity

arabic: الحَمْدُ للهِ
translit: alhamdulillah
english: All praise is to Allah.
title: Supplication After Sneezing

arabic: يَرْحَمُكَ اللهُ
translit: yarhamukallah
english: May Allah have mercy on you.
title: Supplication Upon Hearing Someone Sneeze

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ كَمَا حَسَّنْتَ خَلْقِي فَحَسِّنْ خُلُقِي
translit: allahumma kamaa hassanta kholqii fahassin khuluqii
english: O Allah, just as You have made my external form good, make my character good as well.
source: HR. Ahmad, authenticated by al-Albani in al-Irwa', 1/115
title: Supplication for Good Character

arabic: رَبِّ أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِيْنِ وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَنْ يَحْضُرُوْنِ
translit: rabbi a'uudzu bika min hamazaatisy-syayaathiin wa a'uudzu bika rabbi ay yahdhuruun
english: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the whispers of Satan, and I seek refuge in You, my Lord, from their presence around me.
title: Prayer for Protection from Satan

arabic: رَبَّنَا آَتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآَخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
translit: rabbana atina fi'd-dunya hasanatan wa fi'l-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaban-nar
english: Our Lord! Give us good in this world that and give us good in the Hereafter, and save us from the torment of the hell fire.
title: Dua Seeking Good In This World And In The Hereafter

arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا
translit: rabbana la tuzigh qulubana ba'da idh hadaytana
english: O our Lord, do not make our hearts incline to error after You have guided us.
title: Dua To Make Heart Firm Upon Deen #3

arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِى بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
translit: alhamdu lillahi alladhi bini'matihi tattimmu assalihat
english: Praise be to Allah, by whose grace goodness is perfected.
source: HR. Ibnu Majah in the Sunnan, No. 3803 and al-Hakim in al-Mustadrak (1/499)
title: Dua When Getting Good News
